comment:overrides: 2026-08-28, versions refreshed 2026-09-06. (1) The old `vite: ^7` override was REMOVED with the Astro 7 upgrade. Astro 7.2.9 peers vite ^8.0.13 and its static build calls vite.createBuilder(); pinned to 7.3.3 the build got through the client bundle and then died on 'Could not find the prerender entry point in the build output. This is likely a bug in Astro.' It is not a bug in Astro, it is a silently-downgraded vite. Check Astro's peer range before ever pinning vite again. (2) The two entries below are load-bearing, not cosmetic: a PLAIN dependency pin is proven insufficient because npm will happily nest a newer copy under a dependant. sanity-plugin-utils defaults to 2.0.17, which drags in @sanity/ui v4; @sanity/astro depends on @sanity/visual-editing by caret range and nests a newer copy under @sanity/astro/node_modules, which drags a second @sanity/ui in with it. Either one breaks the one-@sanity/ui-instance invariant that keeps the styled-components theme context alive (PORTS.md card 10). Verify on DISK after any Sanity dependency work, not in the install output: `Get-ChildItem -Recurse node_modules -Filter package.json | Where-Object FullName -like '*@sanity\ui\package.json'` must print exactly one line.
